spec.code:
/-- `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits, or `sha512:` and 128. -/
def DigestShape (d : List Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ h, d = lit "sha256:" ++ h ∧ h.length = 64 ∧ h.all isLowerHex) ∨
  (∃ h, d = lit "sha512:" ++ h ∧ h.length = 128 ∧ h.all isLowerHex)

/-- The UTF-8 bytes of a literal. -/
def lit (s : String) : List Nat := s.toUTF8.toList.map (·.toNat)

spec.name: isLowerHex
spec.code: def isLowerHex (c : Nat) : Bool := (48 ≤ c && c ≤ 57) || (97 ≤ c && c ≤ 102)

/-- [nora_kernel::validation::validate_digest]:
    Source: 'src/validation.rs', lines 250:0-274:1
    Visibility: public -/
def validation.validate_digest
  (digest : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result (core.result.Result Unit validation.ValidationError)
  := do
  let i := Slice.len digest
  if i = 0#usize
  then ok (core.result.Result.Err validation.ValidationError.EmptyInput)
  else
    let b ← validation.contains_pair digest 46#u8 46#u8
    if b
    then ok (core.result.Result.Err validation.ValidationError.PathTraversal)
    else
      let b1 ← validation.contains_byte digest 47#u8
      if b1
      then ok (core.result.Result.Err validation.ValidationError.PathTraversal)
      else
        let o ← validation.find_colon digest
        match o with
        | none =>
          ok (core.result.Result.Err
            validation.ValidationError.DigestNoAlgorithm)
        | some i1 =>
          let i2 := Slice.len digest
          let i3 ← i2 - i1
          let hash_len ← i3 - 1#usize
          let s ←
            lift (Array.to_slice
              (Array.make 6#usize [
                115#u8, 104#u8, 97#u8, 50#u8, 53#u8, 54#u8
                ]))
          let b2 ← validation.prefix_is digest i1 s
          if b2
          then
            if hash_len != 64#usize
            then
              ok (core.result.Result.Err
                validation.ValidationError.DigestLength)
            else let i4 ← i1 + 1#usize
                 validation.digest_hash_chars digest i4
          else
            let s1 ←
              lift (Array.to_slice
                (Array.make 6#usize [
                  115#u8, 104#u8, 97#u8, 53#u8, 49#u8, 50#u8
                  ]))
            let b3 ← validation.prefix_is digest i1 s1
            if b3
            then
              if hash_len != 128#usize
              then
                ok (core.result.Result.Err
                  validation.ValidationError.DigestLength)
              else
                let i4 ← i1 + 1#usize
                validation.digest_hash_chars digest i4
            else
              ok (core.result.Result.Err
                validation.ValidationError.DigestAlgorithm)

import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result nora_kernel nora_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace nora_kernel.Solution

/-! ## The scanning helpers of `validation.rs` -/

@[step] theorem contains_byte_spec (s : Slice U8) (c : U8) :
    validation.contains_byte s c ⦃ b => b = s.val.any (fun x => decide (x = c)) ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.contains_byte validation.contains_byte_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search s.val (fun x => decide (x = c)) (fun b : Bool => b)
    (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; exact search_any _ _ _ hr
  · intro j hj; unfold validation.contains_byte_loop.body; i5h_step

@[step] theorem contains_pair_spec (s : Slice U8) (a b : U8) :
    validation.contains_pair s a b ⦃ r =>
      r = (s.val.zip s.val.tail).any (fun p => decide (p.1 = a ∧ p.2 = b)) ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.contains_pair validation.contains_pair_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search (s.val.zip s.val.tail) (fun p => decide (p.1 = a ∧ p.2 = b))
    (fun b : Bool => b) (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; exact search_any _ _ _ hr
  · intro j hj; unfold validation.contains_pair_loop.body; i5h_step

/-- A search that returns the index of the first match. -/
theorem searchFrom_findIdx {α} (l : List α) (P : α → Bool) (k : Nat) :
    searchFrom l P (fun j _ => some j) none k = ((l.drop k).findIdx? P).map (· + k) := by
  induction h : l.length - k generalizing k with
  | zero => rw [searchFrom_end (by omega), List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)]; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hk : k < l.length := by omega
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hk, List.findIdx?_cons]
    by_cases hp : P l[k]
    · rw [searchFrom_found hk hp]; simp [hp]
    · rw [searchFrom_skip hk hp, ih (k + 1) (by omega)]
      simp [hp, Option.map_map, Function.comp_def]; congr 1; funext x; omega

@[step] theorem find_colon_spec (s : Slice U8) :
    validation.find_colon s ⦃ o =>
      s.val.findIdx? (fun x => decide (x = 58#u8)) = o.map (·.val) ∧
        ∀ k ∈ o, k.val < s.val.length ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.find_colon validation.find_colon_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search s.val (fun x => decide (x = 58#u8))
    (fun o : Option Usize => o.map (·.val)) (fun k _ => some k) none _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr
    rw [searchFrom_findIdx] at hr; simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.drop_zero] at hr
    refine ⟨by simpa using hr.symm, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    rw [Option.mem_def] at hk; subst hk
    obtain ⟨h, -⟩ := List.findIdx?_eq_some_iff_getElem.1 (by simpa using hr.symm)
    exact h
  · intro j hj; unfold validation.find_colon_loop.body; i5h_step

theorem take_eq_of_zip (d l : List U8) (n : Nat) (h : n ≤ d.length) (hl : n = l.length) :
    (if (d.zip l).any (fun p => decide (p.1 ≠ p.2)) then false else true) =
      decide (n = l.length ∧ d.take n = l) := by
  have hz : d.zip l = (d.take n).zip l := by
    subst hl; conv_lhs => rw [List.zip_eq_zip_take_min]
    rw [Nat.min_eq_right h, List.take_length]
  have := zip_all_eq (d.take n) l (by simp; omega)
  rw [hz, List.any_eq_not_all_not]
  simp only [ne_eq, decide_not, Bool.not_not]
  rw [this]; simp [hl]

@[step] theorem prefix_is_spec (d lit : Slice U8) (len : Usize) (h : len.val ≤ d.val.length) :
    validation.prefix_is d len lit ⦃ b =>
      b = decide (len.val = lit.val.length ∧ d.val.take len.val = lit.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.prefix_is; simp only
  split
  · simp_all
  · rename_i hl
    have hl' : len.val = lit.val.length := by simp_all
    unfold validation.prefix_is_loop
    apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search (d.val.zip lit.val) (fun p => decide (p.1 ≠ p.2))
      (fun b : Bool => b) (fun _ _ => false) true _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
    · intro r hr
      rw [hr, searchFrom_const, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.drop_zero]
      exact take_eq_of_zip _ _ _ h hl'
    · intro j hj; unfold validation.prefix_is_loop.body; i5h_step

@[step] theorem is_lower_hex_spec (c : U8) :
    validation.is_lower_hex c ⦃ b => b = isLowerHex c.val ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.is_lower_hex isLowerHex
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> simp_all

def isOk : core.result.Result Unit validation.ValidationError → Bool
  | .Ok _ => true
  | .Err _ => false

@[step] theorem hash_chars_spec (s : Slice U8) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ s.val.length) :
    validation.digest_hash_chars s i ⦃ r =>
      isOk r = !((s.val.drop i.val).any (fun x => !isLowerHex x.val)) ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.digest_hash_chars validation.digest_hash_chars_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search s.val (fun x => !isLowerHex x.val) isOk
    (fun _ _ => false) true _ ?_ i hi)
  · intro r hr; rw [hr, searchFrom_const]; split <;> simp_all
  · intro j hj; unfold validation.digest_hash_chars_loop.body; i5h_step [isOk]

theorem isOk_iff (r : core.result.Result Unit validation.ValidationError) :
    r = .Ok () ↔ isOk r = true := by
  cases r <;> simp [isOk]

/-! ## `validate_digest` over byte lists -/

def sha256 : List U8 := [115#u8, 104#u8, 97#u8, 50#u8, 53#u8, 54#u8]
def sha512 : List U8 := [115#u8, 104#u8, 97#u8, 53#u8, 49#u8, 50#u8]

/-- What `validate_digest` checks, step by step. -/
def Model (d : List U8) : Prop :=
  d ≠ [] ∧ (d.zip d.tail).any (fun p => decide (p.1 = 46#u8 ∧ p.2 = 46#u8)) = false ∧
    d.any (fun x => decide (x = 47#u8)) = false ∧
    ∃ k, d.findIdx? (fun x => decide (x = 58#u8)) = some k ∧
      ((d.take k = sha256 ∧ d.length - k - 1 = 64) ∨
        (d.take k ≠ sha256 ∧ d.take k = sha512 ∧ d.length - k - 1 = 128)) ∧
      (d.drop (k + 1)).any (fun x => !isLowerHex x.val) = false

theorem validate_digest_spec (d : Slice U8) :
    validation.validate_digest d ⦃ r => r = .Ok () ↔ Model d.val ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.validate_digest
  have hlen : d.len.val = d.val.length := by simp
  i5h_steps
  all_goals first
    | (simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_iff]
       rintro ⟨hne, hdots, hslash, k, hk, hcase, hhex⟩
       simp_all [-List.any_eq_false, -List.any_eq_true, sha256, sha512, Array.make, Array.to_slice]
       try omega)
    | (rw [isOk_iff]
       simp_all [-List.any_eq_false, -List.any_eq_true, Model, sha256, sha512, Array.make,
         Array.to_slice])
  -- What is left: the prefix check fixed the colon at 6.
  all_goals first
    | exact hcase.1 (by rw [← b2_post.1]; exact b2_post.2)
    | exact fun _ => by rw [← b2_post.1]; exact b2_post.2
    | exact fun _ => by rw [← b3_post.1]; exact b3_post.2
    | (rcases hcase with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨-, h, -⟩ <;>
       · have h6 := congrArg List.length h
         simp only [List.length_take, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at h6
         have : (↑i1 : Nat) = 6 := by omega
         simp_all)


/-! ## The model is the digest shape -/

theorem lit256 : lit "sha256:" = [115, 104, 97, 50, 53, 54, 58] := by decide +kernel
theorem lit512 : lit "sha512:" = [115, 104, 97, 53, 49, 50, 58] := by decide +kernel

theorem nats_take (L : List U8) (k : Nat) (l : List U8) :
    L.take k = l ↔ (nats L).take k = nats l := by
  rw [nats, nats, ← List.map_take]
  exact (List.map_injective_iff.2 (fun a b h => UScalar.eq_imp a b h)).eq_iff.symm

theorem zip_any_false (L : List U8) (a b : U8) (h : a ∉ L) :
    (L.zip L.tail).any (fun p => decide (p.1 = a ∧ p.2 = b)) = false := by
  rw [List.any_eq_false]
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hm hp
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
  exact h (hp.1 ▸ (List.of_mem_zip hm).1)

theorem model_iff (L : List U8) : Model L ↔ DigestShape (nats L) := by
  have hfind : L.findIdx? (fun x => decide (x = 58#u8)) = (nats L).findIdx? (· = 58) := by
    simp [nats, List.findIdx?_map, Function.comp_def, UScalar.eq_equiv]
  have hhex : ∀ k, (L.drop k).any (fun x => !isLowerHex x.val) = false ↔
      ((nats L).drop k).all isLowerHex = true := by
    intro k; simp [nats, ← List.map_drop]
  have hlenN : L.length = (nats L).length := by simp [nats]
  simp only [Model, hfind, nats_take, hhex, hlenN]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, -, -, k, hk, hcase, hall⟩
    obtain ⟨hk1, hk2, -⟩ := List.findIdx?_eq_some_iff_getElem.1 hk
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hk2
    rcases hcase with ⟨ht, hl⟩ | ⟨-, ht, hl⟩
    · left
      have h6 := congrArg List.length ht
      simp [sha256, nats] at h6
      have : k = 6 := by omega
      subst this
      refine ⟨(nats L).drop 7, ?_, by simp; omega, hall⟩
      conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop 6 (nats L), List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hk1]
      rw [ht, hk2, lit256]; rfl
    · right
      have h6 := congrArg List.length ht
      simp [sha512, nats] at h6
      have : k = 6 := by omega
      subst this
      refine ⟨(nats L).drop 7, ?_, by simp; omega, hall⟩
      conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop 6 (nats L), List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hk1]
      rw [ht, hk2, lit512]; rfl
  · intro hd
    have hmem : ∀ x ∈ L, x.val ≠ 46 ∧ x.val ≠ 47 := by
      intro x hx
      have hx' : x.val ∈ nats L := List.mem_map_of_mem hx
      rcases hd with ⟨h, hN, -, hh⟩ | ⟨h, hN, -, hh⟩ <;>
      · simp only [hN, lit256, lit512] at hx'
        simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.mem_cons] at hx'
        rcases hx' with hx' | hx' | hx' | hx' | hx' | hx' | hx' | hx' <;> try omega
        rw [List.all_eq_true] at hh
        have := hh _ hx'
        simp [isLowerHex] at this
        omega
    have hne : L ≠ [] := by
      rintro rfl
      rcases hd with ⟨h, hN, -⟩ | ⟨h, hN, -⟩ <;> simp [nats, lit256, lit512] at hN
    refine ⟨hne, zip_any_false _ _ _ (fun h => (hmem _ h).1 (by decide)), ?_, 6, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.any_eq_false]
      intro x hx h
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      exact (hmem x hx).2 (by rw [h]; decide)
    · rcases hd with ⟨h, hN, hl, hh⟩ | ⟨h, hN, hl, hh⟩ <;>
      · simp only [ne_eq, nats_take, hN, lit256, lit512]
        simp [sha256, sha512, nats, hl, hh, List.findIdx?_cons]

theorem digest_iff (d : Slice U8) :
    validation.validate_digest d = ok (.Ok ()) ↔ DigestShape (nats d.val) := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hpost⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 (validate_digest_spec d)
  rw [hr, ← model_iff, ← hpost]
  simp

end nora_kernel.Solution

namespace nora_kernel.Solution

@[step] theorem lower_hex_spec (byte : U8) :
    validation.is_lower_hex byte ⦃ result => result = isLowerHex byte.val ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.is_lower_hex isLowerHex
  step*

@[step] theorem hash_chars_spec (digest : Slice U8) (start : Usize)
    (hs : start.val ≤ digest.val.length) :
    validation.digest_hash_chars digest start ⦃ result =>
      result = .Ok () ↔ (nats (digest.val.drop start.val)).all isLowerHex ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.digest_hash_chars validation.digest_hash_chars_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search digest.val (fun byte => !isLowerHex byte.val)
    (fun result : core.result.Result Unit validation.ValidationError => match result with | .Ok _ => true | .Err _ => false)
    (fun _ _ => false) true _ ?_ start hs)
  · intro result hr
    rw [searchFrom_const] at hr
    have hn : (nats (digest.val.drop start.val)).all isLowerHex =
        (digest.val.drop start.val).all (fun byte => isLowerHex byte.val) := by
      simp only [nats, List.all_map, Function.comp_def]
    rw [hn]
    cases result <;> simpa [List.all_eq_not_any_not] using congrArg (· = true) hr
  · intro index hindex
    unfold validation.digest_hash_chars_loop.body
    i5h_step

@[step] theorem contains_byte_spec (digest : Slice U8) (byte : U8) :
    validation.contains_byte digest byte ⦃ result => result = digest.val.any (fun value => decide (value = byte)) ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.contains_byte validation.contains_byte_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search digest.val (fun value => decide (value = byte)) id
    (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro result hr
    exact search_any _ _ _ hr
  · intro index hindex
    unfold validation.contains_byte_loop.body
    i5h_step

@[step] theorem contains_pair_absent (digest : Slice U8) (first second : U8)
    (hbound : digest.val.length < Usize.max) (ha : first ∉ digest.val) :
    validation.contains_pair digest first second ⦃ result => result = false ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.contains_pair validation.contains_pair_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun index : Usize => digest.val.length - index.val)
    (inv := fun index => index.val ≤ digest.val.length)
  · intro index hindex
    unfold validation.contains_pair_loop.body
    step*
    simp_all
  · simp

def ColonResult (digest : Slice U8) : Option Usize → Prop
  | none => ∀ byte ∈ digest.val, byte.val ≠ 58
  | some index => index.val < digest.val.length ∧ (nats digest.val)[index.val]? = some 58 ∧
      ∀ offset < index.val, (nats digest.val)[offset]? ≠ some 58

@[step] theorem find_colon_spec (digest : Slice U8) :
    validation.find_colon digest ⦃ result => ColonResult digest result ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.find_colon validation.find_colon_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun index : Usize => digest.val.length - index.val)
    (inv := fun index => index.val ≤ digest.val.length ∧
      ∀ offset < index.val, (nats digest.val)[offset]? ≠ some 58)
  · intro index hindex
    unfold validation.find_colon_loop.body
    step*
    all_goals try dsimp only [ColonResult]
    all_goals try grind [nats, u8_eq_iff]
    intro byte hc he
    obtain ⟨offset, hoffset, hvalue⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hc
    have hn := hindex.2 offset (by scalar_tac)
    apply hn
    simp [nats, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hoffset, hvalue, he]
  · simp

theorem prefix_indices_spec (digest : Slice U8) (len : Usize) (text : Slice U8)
    (hbound : len.val ≤ digest.val.length) :
    validation.prefix_is digest len text ⦃ result => result = true ↔
      len.val = text.val.length ∧ ∀ offset < len.val, digest.val[offset]? = text.val[offset]? ⦄ := by
  unfold validation.prefix_is
  dsimp only
  split
  · simp only [WP.spec_ok]
    scalar_tac
  · rename_i hlen
    have hlength : len.val = text.val.length := by scalar_tac
    unfold validation.prefix_is_loop
    apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun index : Usize => len.val - index.val)
      (inv := fun index => index.val ≤ len.val ∧
        ∀ offset < index.val, digest.val[offset]? = text.val[offset]?)
    · intro index hindex
      unfold validation.prefix_is_loop.body
      step*
      all_goals try grind
    · simp

theorem take_eq_of_indices {Element : Type} (values text : List Element)
    (hindices : ∀ offset < text.length, values[offset]? = text[offset]?) :
    values.take text.length = text := by
  apply List.ext_getElem?
  intro offset
  by_cases hoffset : offset < text.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_take_of_lt hoffset]
    exact hindices offset hoffset
  · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp; omega), List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]

@[step] theorem prefix_spec (digest : Slice U8) (len : Usize) (text : Slice U8)
    (hbound : len.val ≤ digest.val.length) :
    validation.prefix_is digest len text ⦃ result => result = true ↔
      len.val = text.val.length ∧ digest.val.take len.val = text.val ⦄ := by
  apply WP.spec_mono (prefix_indices_spec digest len text hbound)
  intro result hb
  rw [hb]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlen, hi⟩
    exact ⟨hlen, hlen ▸ take_eq_of_indices digest.val text.val (by simpa [hlen] using hi)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hlen, heq⟩
    refine ⟨hlen, ?_⟩
    intro offset hoffset
    rw [← List.getElem?_take_of_lt hoffset, heq]

@[simp] theorem lit_sha256 : lit "sha256:" = [115, 104, 97, 50, 53, 54, 58] := by
  unfold lit
  rw [String.toUTF8_eq_toByteArray, ← String.utf8Encode_toList]
  simp [List.utf8Encode, ByteArray.toList, ByteArray.toList.loop, String.utf8EncodeChar]
  simp [ByteArray.get!, List.toByteArray, List.toByteArray.loop]

@[simp] theorem lit_sha512 : lit "sha512:" = [115, 104, 97, 53, 49, 50, 58] := by
  unfold lit
  rw [String.toUTF8_eq_toByteArray, ← String.utf8Encode_toList]
  simp [List.utf8Encode, ByteArray.toList, ByteArray.toList.loop, String.utf8EncodeChar]
  simp [ByteArray.get!, List.toByteArray, List.toByteArray.loop]

theorem nats_eq_iff (values text : List U8) : nats values = nats text ↔ values = text := by
  exact List.map_inj_right (fun left right heq => (u8_eq_iff left right).mpr heq)

theorem prefix_eq (digest : Slice U8) (len : Usize) (text : Slice U8)
    (hbound : len.val ≤ digest.val.length) :
    validation.prefix_is digest len text = ok (decide
      (len.val = text.val.length ∧ nats (digest.val.take len.val) = nats text.val)) := by
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  apply WP.spec_mono (prefix_spec digest len text hbound)
  intro result hb
  rw [← nats_eq_iff (digest.val.take len.val) text.val] at hb
  cases result
  · exact false_eq_decide_iff.mpr (by simpa using hb)
  · exact true_eq_decide_iff.mpr (hb.mp rfl)

theorem find_colon_six (digest : Slice U8)
    (hcolon : (nats digest.val)[6]? = some 58)
    (hbefore : ∀ offset < 6, (nats digest.val)[offset]? ≠ some 58) :
    validation.find_colon digest = ok (some 6#usize) := by
  apply eq_ok_of_spec
  apply WP.spec_mono (find_colon_spec digest)
  intro result hr
  cases result with
  | none =>
    dsimp only [ColonResult] at hr
    have hm := List.mem_of_getElem? hcolon
    obtain ⟨byte, hc, he⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hm
    exact False.elim (hr byte hc he)
  | some index =>
    dsimp only [ColonResult] at hr
    have hi : index.val = 6 := by
      by_cases hsmall : index.val < 6
      · exact False.elim (hbefore index.val hsmall hr.2.1)
      by_cases hlarge : 6 < index.val
      · exact False.elim (hr.2.2 6 hlarge hcolon)
      omega
    have heq : index = 6#usize := by scalar_tac
    simp [heq]

theorem digest_complete (digest : Slice U8) (hshape : DigestShape (nats digest.val)) :
    validation.validate_digest digest = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  rcases hshape with ⟨hash, hd, hlen, hhex⟩ | ⟨hash, hd, hlen, hhex⟩
  all_goals
    simp only [lit_sha256, lit_sha512] at hd
    have hdlen : digest.val.length = hash.length + 7 := by
      have he := congrArg List.length hd
      simp only [nats, List.length_map, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at he
      omega
    have hbound : digest.val.length < Usize.max := by scalar_tac
    have hcolon : (nats digest.val)[6]? = some 58 := by simp [hd]
    have hbefore : ∀ offset < 6, (nats digest.val)[offset]? ≠ some 58 := by
      intro offset hoffset
      have hcases : offset = 0 ∨ offset = 1 ∨ offset = 2 ∨ offset = 3 ∨ offset = 4 ∨ offset = 5 := by omega
      rcases hcases with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp [hd]
    have hc := find_colon_six digest hcolon hbefore
    have hbad : ∀ byte ∈ hash, byte ≠ 46 ∧ byte ≠ 47 := by
      intro byte hmem
      have hh := List.all_eq_true.mp hhex byte hmem
      simp [isLowerHex] at hh
      omega
    have hdot : 46#u8 ∉ digest.val := by
      intro hmem
      have hn : 46 ∈ nats digest.val := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨46#u8, hmem, rfl⟩
      have hm : 46 ∈ hash := by simpa [hd] using hn
      exact (hbad 46 hm).1 rfl
    have hslash : 47#u8 ∉ digest.val := by
      intro hmem
      have hn : 47 ∈ nats digest.val := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨47#u8, hmem, rfl⟩
      have hm : 47 ∈ hash := by simpa [hd] using hn
      exact (hbad 47 hm).2 rfl
    have hp := eq_ok_of_spec (contains_pair_absent digest 46#u8 46#u8 hbound hdot)
    have hb : validation.contains_byte digest 47#u8 = ok false := by
      apply eq_ok_of_spec
      apply WP.spec_mono (contains_byte_spec digest 47#u8)
      intro result he
      rw [he]
      apply List.any_eq_false.mpr
      intro byte hmem
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
      exact fun heq => hslash (heq ▸ hmem)
    have hdrop : nats (digest.val.drop 7) = hash := by
      simpa only [nats, List.map_drop] using (show (nats digest.val).drop 7 = hash by simp [hd])
    have hh : validation.digest_hash_chars digest 7#usize = ok (.Ok ()) := by
      apply eq_ok_of_spec
      apply WP.spec_mono (hash_chars_spec digest 7#usize (by scalar_tac))
      intro result hr
      exact hr.mpr (by simpa [hdrop] using hhex)
    have ht256 := prefix_eq digest 6#usize (Array.to_slice (Array.make 6#usize
      [115#u8, 104#u8, 97#u8, 50#u8, 53#u8, 54#u8])) (by scalar_tac)
    have ht512 := prefix_eq digest 6#usize (Array.to_slice (Array.make 6#usize
      [115#u8, 104#u8, 97#u8, 53#u8, 49#u8, 50#u8])) (by scalar_tac)
    have hdmap := hd
    unfold nats at hdmap
    simp [nats, Array.make_val, List.map_take, hdmap] at ht256 ht512
    have hempty : digest.len ≠ 0#usize := by scalar_tac
    have hadd : (6#usize + 1#usize : Result Usize) = ok 7#usize := by
      apply eq_ok_of_spec
      apply WP.spec_mono (Usize.add_spec (by scalar_tac))
      intro result hr
      scalar_tac
    unfold validation.validate_digest
    rw [hp, hb, hc]
    simp only [if_neg hempty, bind_ok, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, lift]
    simp only [ht256, ht512, bind_ok, if_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    rw [hadd]
    simp only [bind_ok, hh]
    apply eq_ok_of_spec
    step*

theorem digest_split (digest : Slice U8) (hcolon : (nats digest.val)[6]? = some 58) :
    nats digest.val = nats (digest.val.take 6) ++ [58] ++ nats (digest.val.drop 7) := by
  have heq := List.take_append_drop 7 (nats digest.val)
  rw [show 7 = 6 + 1 from rfl, List.take_add_one, hcolon] at heq
  simpa only [nats, List.map_take, List.map_drop, Option.toList_some] using heq.symm

theorem digest_sound (digest : Slice U8)
    (hvalid : validation.validate_digest digest = ok (.Ok ())) : DigestShape (nats digest.val) := by
  unfold validation.validate_digest at hvalid
  simp only [lift] at hvalid
  i5h_invert hvalid
  case' h_2.isTrue.isFalse =>
    rename_i pos hcolon diff hsub hashlen hsub2 text htext prefix_result hpre htrue hlen start hadd
  case' h_2.isFalse.isTrue.isFalse =>
    rename_i pos hcolon diff hsub hashlen hsub2 text256 htext256 b256 hp256 hfalse text htext prefix_result hpre htrue hlen start hadd
  all_goals
      have hc := post_of_ok (find_colon_spec digest) hcolon
      dsimp only [ColonResult] at hc
      have hp := (post_of_ok (prefix_spec digest pos text (by omega)) hpre).mp htrue
      have hdifference := post_of_ok (Usize.sub_spec (by scalar_tac)) hsub
      have hh := post_of_ok (Usize.sub_spec (by scalar_tac)) hsub2
      have hs := post_of_ok (Usize.add_spec (by scalar_tac)) hadd
      have hx := (post_of_ok (hash_chars_spec digest start (by scalar_tac)) hvalid).mp rfl
      simp only [← htext, Array.to_slice, Slice.from_val, Array.make_val,
        List.length_cons, List.length_nil, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, Nat.reduceAdd] at hc hp hx hs hh hdifference
      have hpos : pos.val = 6 := hp.1
      simp only [hpos, Nat.reduceAdd] at hc hs
      simp only [hs] at hx
      have hsplit := digest_split digest hc.2.1
      have hprefix := congrArg nats hp.2
      rw [hp.1] at hprefix
      simp only [nats, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hprefix
      change nats (digest.val.take 6) = _ at hprefix
      first
      | (left
         refine ⟨nats (digest.val.drop 7), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
         · simpa [hprefix] using hsplit
         · simp only [nats, List.length_map, List.length_drop]
           scalar_tac
         · exact hx)
      | (right
         refine ⟨nats (digest.val.drop 7), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
         · simpa [hprefix] using hsplit
         · simp only [nats, List.length_map, List.length_drop]
           scalar_tac
         · exact hx)

theorem digest_iff (d : Slice U8) :
    validation.validate_digest d = ok (.Ok ()) ↔ DigestShape (nats d.val) := by
  exact ⟨digest_sound d, digest_complete d⟩

end nora_kernel.Solution
